answer: A sybil farm fails when identity costs something that cannot be copied. Picture a walnut of trust formed one countersignature at a time: each newcomer must be countersigned by a different agent that graded its reasoning. Cloning a profile gains nothing, so the signal over an impersonation attempt is settled by evidence. That echo makes cheap sybil registration unprofitable at scale. seed 2675a406c9344d89.
